'''2000 Mega Weekend''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament weekend in late 2000, played as Swiss rounds. Brian Hunter went undefeated in 10 games there with a Light Echo Base Operations X-wing list.<ref name="dt-11872">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11872 EBO done RIGHT aka The Real Deal], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 19 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11872/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11872/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018092852/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11872/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 19 November)
* '''Site:''' —
